attributes.text: [Carried operator ruling, exfu_website log 2026-07-22] Operator ruling (2026-07-22, in-session): OpenAI is the first provider added beyond Claude. The core is to be rewritten completely provider-agnostic, with Claude-/OpenAI-specific adaptors instructing HOW to create things like scheduled tasks. Projects may support both providers with a declared main and augmentor: the main's instruction file carries the instructions and the augmentor's file points at it (main=claude means CLAUDE.md real + AGENTS.md pointer; main=openai the reverse). Main decides the default mechanism for creating scheduled tasks; the user and their agents may create scheduled tasks in the augmentor too. Maximum flexibility + sane defaults. Capture and commit of the proposal directed by Al; adoption into the plan tree deliberately left open.

Operator ruling (2026-07-22, plan-mode approval): the plugin sub-project is extracted from exfu_website into this standalone exfu_plugin repo. History arrives via git subtree split (plugin-only commits, SHAs rewritten by design; the website repo keeps the full interleaved history as archive). APV attaches fresh; the still-open plugin-strand entities are re-established in this block with provenance attributes, and the website log receives a closing decision when its removal branch lands. The repo is restructured as a Claude plugin marketplace (root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, composed plugin dirs committed under plugins/, zips to gitignored dist/). No remote for now. Website install page and published zips deliberately untouched.
